module: Ruckus Networks SmartZone 104 (SZ-104), SmartZone 124 (SZ-124) and SmartZone 300 (SZ-300) WLAN Controllers
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and installed, initialized and configured as specified in Sections 2 and 8 of the Security Policy. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy
description: SmartZone network controllers simplify network set-up and management, enhance security, minimize troubleshooting and ease upgrades for networks built on Ruckus access points and switches. It doesn't stop there. Whether you're building complex multi-geo networks or delivering multi-tier managed networking services, SmartZone network controllers deliver the scale, flexibility and openness to support the most sophisticated deployment scenarios.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C1647, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 128 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C706 with CVL Cert. #C706, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 192 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C706 with CVL Cert. #1647, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 192 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C706 with CVL Cert. #1647, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG
hardware_versions: PF1-S104-US00, RevA; PF1-S124-US00, RevA; PF1-S300-WW00, RevA; PF1-S300-WW10, RevA
